items.prompt: What does span<const long long> establish by itself?

options.text: It owns and authenticates all account data
options.why: It is a borrowed sequence view, not an authenticated owner.

options.text: It grants read-only element access through that view
options.why: Storage lifetime and alias/concurrency safety remain caller obligations.

options.text: It prevents every other alias from changing storage
options.why: const access through one view is not global immutability.

options.text: It checks any arbitrary pointer/extent pair is live
options.why: A span must already refer to valid storage under its contract.

items.explanation: The interface must state the source lifetime and concurrency conditions in addition to using const access.
